results.title: Conference Board: Consumer Confidence Ticks Down in August

results.content:
The emphasis on inflation concerns in the end-of-month survey results differs from the focus on deteriorating business conditions that dominated consumer concerns at the beginning of August.

Sentiment on current and future business conditions remained overwhelmingly gloomy, however. The index tracking current economic conditions declined 5.3% from June and was nearly 16% lower than a year ago at 51.9, roughly matching the preliminary findings. [...] The overall index of consumer expectations slid 7% on a monthly basis and about 8% on a year-over-year basis to land at 51.5.
